cold_main_worker_context.purpose: environment and operation probes run in disposable child processes

lambda_calibration: lambda = target_ratio * ||g_diffusion|| / ||projected_g_geometry|| at the common initial model on a deterministic t=0..99 batch
projection_rule: if group dot(g_geometry,g_diffusion)<0, g_geometry <- g_geometry - dot/||g_diffusion||^2 * g_diffusion

resume1_output_lifecycle.new_lifecycle: mktemp -d creates only a directory; environment.json must not exist before worker invocation
resume1_output_lifecycle.old_lifecycle: mktemp FILE_TEMPLATE created the output file before atomic_write_once
